Primary Methods establish a PsaB His20 tag. The literal entity mutation string No and the RCSB mutation flag are not used to infer an unmodified wild-type sample.
Study conditions: TAP medium, 25 °C, continuous light about 20 µmol photons m−2 s−1. The deposited core model does not establish absence of cytochrome c6 from the experimental preparation.
Monomeric PSI-LHCI: 13 core and four Lhca subunits. The primary study used Tak-1 and Tak-2 accessions; the specific accession represented by this grid remains unassigned.

Monomer preparation used 3.6% α-DDM solubilization and 0.03% α-DDM thereafter. Growth was at 20 °C under continuous 10–15 μmol photons m−2 s−1 light. The related 9LUU dimer used a different preparation.
Primary-study growth: 30 µmol photons m−2 s−1, 30 °C, air with 3% CO2. Different C. caldarium strains or preparations are not pooled as identical conditions.
P_A-network residue mapping and water position were recomputed for this entry; a cyanobacterial template is not treated as a conservation claim.

facts: Sample: Pisum sativum var. Alaska (pea). Cultivation follows Qin et al. (2015); detailed growth parameters and engineering status are not independently established here.
Source taxonomy: deposited name Pisum sativum; current RCSB taxonomic display Lathyrus oleraceus, taxon 3888. These labels refer to the same source taxon in this entry.

Purification used β-DDM, followed by β-DDTM during the final sucrose gradient. Crystallization used sitting drops at 285 K; the paper discusses pH 9.0 crystallization. These conditions do not establish the cause of quinone distortion.
P_A is deposited as CLA; atom/component identities are retained. The source component label is not an independent chlorophyll epimer assignment.

cautions.text: Curator note: The unusually bent A1 quinones and elongated C–O bonds are present in the deposited 7DKZ model. I have verified the coordinates and am working on interpretations; their physical significance remains unresolved. See the 7DKZ quinone review.
Deposited site water A923 has weak, contour-sensitive map support (about 1.09 full-cell σ; below 1.5 σ). Its modeled position is retained.

facts: PSI–9 FCPI is the α-DDM preparation: 0.5% α-DDM solubilization; final cryo-EM buffer contained 0.05% α-DDM. The PSI–4 FCPI classes came from the same fraction; the 1/6/8-FCPI reconstructions came from SML.

Culture: seawater F/2 medium, 20 °C, air with 3% CO2, continuous light 4.60 μmol photons m−2 s−1, 20 days. Antenna classes describe preparations/reconstructions, not an ordered acclimation series or independent biological replicates.
Split PsaA: author chain A is the pocket-bearing C-terminal fragment, chain a the N-terminal fragment; PsaB is chain B. The pocket display frame uses A/B; the neighborhood screen includes A/a/B.

Preparation and map: SEC Dataset 1 and native-PAGE Dataset 2 were combined for the 1.84 Å consensus reconstruction; focused maps were merged into the composite EMD-52518 map used for model building. 9HYU is not assigned to only one purification dataset.
P_A O1D has Tyr602 OH and Thr742 OG1 N/O proximity candidates at 3.08575 and 3.30006 Å. Donor hydrogens, protonation and angles were not verified; these are not confirmed hydrogen bonds.

The deposited P_A Mg to homologous His679 NE2 separation is 3.05697 Å, beyond the automatic discovery cutoff of 3.0 Å. An explicit source-hash-bound mapping report establishes the cofactor role by sequence and nearest-anchor identity; the general cutoff is unchanged.

Primary study: Rhodomonas sp. NIES-2332 cells grown in F/2 medium at 20 °C with 3% CO2. PsaA/PsaB sequences were obtained from cDNA; several smaller core subunits were modeled using R. salina sequences.

Source-geometry caution: deposited quinone C–O distances are 1.39311–1.39568 Å, with official carbonyl bond Z scores about +7.8 to +7.9. Strong density and ring planarity do not establish correct carbonyl chemistry; hold quantitative A₁ chemical-geometry/redox interpretation.

cautions.text: Source-geometry caution: The deposited quinone C–O bonds are unusually long (1.393–1.396 Å). These coordinates do not establish quinone chemistry or redox state.
P_A Mg–His679 NE2 is 3.05697 Å. Cofactor identity is supported by the reviewed mapping; normal axial coordination is not established.

facts: Primary study identifies five FCPI subunits associated with one PSI core from strain CCMP1335. Native assembly and antenna architecture are not inferred from the cropped contact scenes.
The deposited initial-model category records an experimental model with source Other but no accession. An explicit starting PDB accession is not assigned from that category.

Primary model-building Methods use ModelAngelo, postprocessed and Topaz-denoised maps, followed by refinement including protein-cofactor coordination restraints. This is source-study processing, not processing performed by this atlas.
